abstract: Fiverr's FY2025 financial results provide a market-based signal of AI's impact on freelance labor demand, particularly in knowledge work categories. The company reported revenue declines in AI-exposed service categories — writing, translation, and simple coding tasks — where generative AI tools can directly substitute for human freelancers. Simultaneously, complex creative and strategic services that require human judgment, taste, or client interaction showed growth, revealing a bifurcation in freelance demand along the AI-substitutability axis. Fiverr operates as a leading marketplace for freelance digital services, making its category-level performance data a real-time indicator of which types of knowledge work face the most immediate AI displacement pressure. The divergence between AI-substitutable and AI-complementary service categories within the same platform provides unusually clean evidence of how AI is reshaping demand for human labor across different task types.
keyFindings: AI-exposed categories (writing, translation, simple coding) experienced the largest revenue declines, directly reflecting reduced demand for human labor in tasks where generative AI can substitute.
Complex creative and strategic services grew, indicating that AI displacement is concentrated in routinizable knowledge work while demand for judgment-intensive human services remains robust.
The within-platform divergence between AI-substitutable and AI-complementary categories provides real-time market evidence of task-level displacement that aligns with theoretical predictions.

Fiverr's results serve as a leading indicator for broader freelance and gig economy trends, where workers lack the institutional buffers (contracts, retraining programs) available to traditional employees.
methodology: Publicly reported quarterly and annual financial results from Fiverr International Ltd., a major online marketplace for freelance digital services. Category-level revenue and active buyer data provide granular insight into demand shifts across service types. Market data covering FY2025 (calendar year 2025).
qualifiers: Fiverr represents one marketplace platform and may not fully represent the broader freelance economy. Revenue declines in specific categories could reflect pricing pressure, competitive dynamics, or platform-specific factors beyond AI substitution. The company does not publicly report granular category-level revenue breakdowns, limiting precise quantification. Fiverr's user base skews toward cost-sensitive buyers who may be more willing to switch to AI alternatives than enterprise clients.
